task.title: P6-140: Fix shared pending signal that disables every Owned-elsewhere row on one Pull
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Needs, shopping and pull). Original id: P6-140. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.
